name: Suou Hijiri
source:
A devoted nun with a very particular sense of smell. 

[spoiler]When she was still a baby, she was abandoned by her delusional mother, which later led Hijiri to believe she is an angel. Her given name is actually Suou Alice, hence her mother calling her A-chan.[/spoiler]
